title: Sapling SMP
description: Welcome to Sapling.gg! A next generation of Minecraft survival servers! Founded in 2024, Sapling.gg is where innovation meets community-driven gameplay, offering an experience that’s as unique as it is engaging.
body:
Welcome to Sapling.gg, the community is dedicated to you. A small tight-knit and soft-whitelisted community built for players who want to relax, build or to have a good time. Whether you're here to chill with friends, start your next adventure or just enjoy some time solo in the terrain of Sapling SMP.

Here at Sapling, we put players first, and that shows everything. From welcoming to our no pressure gameplay. Claim your territory, build freely and don't worry about anyone getting in your way. With no upkeep costs your land stay sage no matter how big!

**Features:**

🖼️ 1.21.11 Survival

🛡️ Land Claiming

👷‍♂️ Jobs, Skills and Quests!

⭐ Milestones & Achievements

🏪 Player Shops

🪑 Custom Furniture

🎮 Levelling System

📦 Daily login rewards
